title: IoTプロトタイピング(夏期集中講義)
subtitle: IoT Prototyping
courseType:
(Provided by all courses)

educationalGoal: Learn prototyping methods using microcontrollers to build IoT systems. - Be able to understand the concept and process of prototyping. - Be able to understand how to use microcontroller-based sensors and actuators and how to use networks as basic knowledge required to build IoT systems. - Be able to propose and prototype IoT systems individually and in teams.
advice: In this course, students will learn how to use microcontrollers to configure IoT systems, while creating and evaluating prototypes of their own (or their team's) proposed ideas. 1. Introduction to IoT Prototyping 2. Microcontroller exercise for prototyping 3. Prototyping preparation (individual) 4. Prototyping (team) 5. Evaluation and review 6. Prototyping (team) 7. Evaluation and review
requiredKnowledge: No specialized knowledge is required for the course. Basic computer literacy (Windows/Office operation, typing, etc.) is required. Programming experience is not required. Because, microcomputer development is basically done by visual programming.

activityGoals.body: To be able to explain the concept and methods of IoT prototyping.
To be able to develop IoT devices with sensors, actuators and microcontrollers.
To be able to construct IoT systems using networks.
To be able to make proposals to use IoT systems to solve actual problems.
